title: Director of Marketing

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: MUTOH has been honored by PRINTING United Alliance for 13 consecutive years and actively exhibits at major industry trade shows (PRINTING United Expo 2025, SEMA 2025), demonstrating sophisticated marketing execution and industry leadership positioning. The Director of Marketing would be responsible for brand positioning, competitive differentiation messaging, and customer education programs. Incorporating Tedlar into MUTOH's marketing strategy provides powerful proof points: they can promote complete durability solutions (not just printers), educate customers on extending graphics lifespan with premium overlaminates, and create co-marketing opportunities with DuPont's 60+ year brand heritage. This enables stronger messaging around total cost of ownership, premium quality positioning, and thought leadership in outdoor/durable graphics applications. This role cares about brand perception, marketing campaign ROI, competitive differentiation, lead generation quality, and customer education effectiveness—all enhanced by association with industry-leading Tedlar protective films.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: The Director of Marketing at MUTOH oversees brand positioning, competitive messaging, customer education initiatives, and trade show strategy. They influence how MUTOH differentiates itself in the wide-format printing market and likely manage marketing budgets for events like PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) and SEMA Show 2025. They work closely with product management and sales teams to create compelling value propositions for MUTOH's printer/ink solutions. While they don't own technical specifications, they own the story around why customers should choose MUTOH over competitors—making them critical for incorporating partner solutions into customer-facing narratives.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: MUTOH's customers produce vehicle wraps, outdoor signage, banners, and large-format graphics—exactly where Tedlar excels. For the Director of Marketing, Tedlar represents a marketing asset: they can position MUTOH as offering complete durability solutions by recommending Tedlar overlaminates alongside their eco-solvent and UV-LED printers. This creates differentiated messaging around 'graphics that last 12-20+ years,' 'graffiti-resistant vehicle wraps,' and 'outdoor signage that doesn't fade or crack.' At trade shows where MUTOH exhibits (PRINTING United, SEMA), they could demonstrate complete application workflows—print on MUTOH equipment, protect with Tedlar—positioning MUTOH as a total solution provider rather than just hardware vendor.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This role owns brand perception, competitive differentiation, marketing campaign effectiveness, and customer education quality. Their KPIs likely include brand awareness metrics, trade show lead generation, customer engagement rates, and competitive win rates. They care about creating compelling customer stories, establishing thought leadership in outdoor/durable graphics, and building marketing programs that support sales teams. Tedlar solves a key marketing challenge: MUTOH can differentiate by promoting complete solutions (printer + protective film) that address end-user pain points like premature fading, UV damage, graffiti vandalism, and high replacement costs. This creates stronger marketing narratives, better customer education content, and more impactful trade show demonstrations.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: MUTOH is exhibiting at PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) and SEMA Show 2025, with active product launches including the HydrAton printer in 2025 and recent eco-solvent printer unveilings at PRINTING United 2024. The company has won four Pinnacle Product Awards in 2024 and been honored by PRINTING United Alliance for 13 consecutive years, indicating they're in active marketing campaign mode. NOW is an ideal time to reach out because they're planning trade show strategies, developing product launch messaging, and looking for differentiation angles ahead of major industry events. Their focus on innovation and awards creates openness to new partnership opportunities that strengthen their competitive positioning.

personalization_hooks.hook: MUTOH is exhibiting at PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) and planning trade show strategy for showcasing complete application solutions
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their upcoming PRINTING United presence and suggest a conversation about demonstrating complete durability workflows (MUTOH printers + Tedlar protective films) at the booth. Position this as a differentiation opportunity to show attendees end-to-end solutions rather than standalone hardware, which strengthens their competitive story against other printer manufacturers.

personalization_hooks.hook: MUTOH's customers (vehicle wrap installers, sign manufacturers, outdoor graphics producers) consistently face challenges with graphics failing prematurely due to UV exposure, graffiti, and weather damage
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar as enabling better customer education programs: MUTOH can teach their customers how to protect printed graphics and extend lifespan dramatically. This positions MUTOH as a trusted advisor solving real installer pain points, not just selling equipment. personalization_hooks.hook: MUTOH has won four Pinnacle Product Awards in 2024 and been recognized for 13 consecutive years by PRINTING United Alliance, demonstrating commitment to innovation and quality leadership
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Connect Tedlar's proven track record with MUTOH's award-winning reputation. Suggest co-marketing opportunities that leverage both brands' quality positioning—MUTOH's cutting-edge printing technology paired with protective films that have decades of proven outdoor performance. This strengthens their premium market positioning and creates compelling joint messaging for industry publications and case studies.

recommended_approach: Lead with their upcoming PRINTING United Expo 2025 presence and frame Tedlar as a trade show differentiation opportunity. Emphasize the marketing value of demonstrating complete solutions (not just printers) and creating stronger customer education narratives around graphics protection. Position this as a strategic conversation about competitive positioning rather than a product pitch.
